name: svg-navigator---chrome-extension
description: SVG Navigator is a browser extension that adds pan and zoom features to existing SVG files on the web.

scripts.start:chrome: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox dev chrome --src src
scripts.start:safari: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox dev safari --src src
scripts.build:chrome: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build chrome --src src
scripts.build:firefox: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build firefox --src src
scripts.build:safari: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build safari --src src
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:safari
scripts.zip:source: zip -r svg-navigator-source.zip src scripts eslint.config.mjs package.json pnpm-lock.yaml README.md web-ext-config.mjs LICENSE.txt -x "**/node_modules/*"
scripts.build:dev: pnpm run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build chrome --src src -t .build/chrome -o dev-chrome && webextension-toolbox build firefox --src src -t .build/firefox -o dev-firefox

author: Peter Ryszkiewicz
